# @weight 1

busybox's dc, the one built on bc's numbers (miscutils/bc.c, FEATURE_DC_BIG).
Every expectation is busybox's own output, from a busybox built from its
source, run as an ordinary user, less the banner line its usage text starts
with.  A `|` marks the end of each line written to standard output; output
that is not text is shown as its bytes in hex, 32 to a line.

## the fixtures

### the files, which busybox made, and a run of dc in a fresh directory

`add.dc`, `quit.dc`, `zero.dc` and `comment.dc` are dc programs, and
`line.txt` a line for ? to read.  Each run is in `/tmp/x-cu-dc/w`, made
afresh from them, with standard input the file IN (`-` for none).

```cu
(do (proc-run (list "/bin/sh" "-c" "rm -rf /tmp/x-cu-dc && mkdir -p /tmp/x-cu-dc/w")) (def dc-f (fn (_ n) (string-append "/tmp/x-cu-dc/" n))) (file-write-all (dc-f "fx.b64") "") (proc-run (list "/bin/sh" "-c" "cd /tmp/x-cu-dc && base64 -d < fx.b64 > fx.tar")) (def dc-home (Sys getcwd)) (def dc-sh (fn (_ cmd out) (proc-run (list "/bin/sh" "-c" (%str-concat (list "cd /tmp/x-cu-dc/w && { " cmd "; } > " out " 2>&1")))))) (def dc-in (fn (_ name) (if (string=? name "-") "" (let ((fd (file-open-read (string-append "/tmp/x-cu-dc/w/" name))) (buf (str-make-raw 65536))) (let ((n (File read fd buf 65536))) (do (file-close fd) (pair buf n))))))) (def dc-norm (fn (_ f) (do (proc-run (list "/bin/sh" "-c" (%str-concat (list "sed -E 's#[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2} [0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}#TIME#' " f " > " f ".n")))) (file-read-all (string-append f ".n"))))) (def dc-shown (fn (_ mode) (if (string=? mode "x") (do (proc-run (list "/bin/sh" "-c" "od -An -v -tx1 /tmp/x-cu-dc/o | tr -d ' \\n' | fold -w 64 > /tmp/x-cu-dc/hex; echo >> /tmp/x-cu-dc/hex")) (file-read-all (dc-f "hex"))) (Str8 replace "\n" "|\n" (dc-norm (dc-f "o")))))) (def dc-case (fn (_ fresh in pre post mode argv) (do (if fresh (dc-sh "cd /tmp/x-cu-dc && rm -rf w && mkdir w && cd w && tar xf ../fx.tar" "/dev/null") ()) (if (string=? pre "@") () (dc-sh pre "/dev/null")) (def dc-stdin (dc-in in)) (Sys chdir "/tmp/x-cu-dc/w") (sys-dup2 1 9) (sys-dup2 2 8) (def st (let ((oo (file-open-write (dc-f "o"))) (ee (file-open-write (dc-f "e")))) (do (sys-dup2 oo 1) (sys-dup2 ee 2) (def rs (cu-run argv dc-stdin)) (sys-dup2 9 1) (sys-dup2 8 2) (file-close oo) (file-close ee) rs))) (Sys chdir dc-home) (display (%str-concat (list (dc-shown mode) "stderr:\n" (file-read-all (dc-f "e")) "status " (cu-int->str st) "\n" (if (string=? post "@") "" (do (dc-sh post (dc-f "p")) (string-append "after:\n" (file-read-all (dc-f "p"))))))))))) (display "made"))
```

    made

## arithmetic

### + - * / % ^ on integers; / and % truncate toward zero; ~ leaves both; p prints the top, f the whole stack, top first

```cu
(do (dc-case #t "-" "@" "@" "-" (list "dc" "-e" "2 3+p")) (dc-case #t "-" "@" "@" "-" (list "dc" "-e" "10 3-p")) (dc-case #t "-" "@" "@" "-" (list "dc" "-e" "6 7*p")) (dc-case #t "-" "@" "@" "-" (list "dc" "-e" "10 3/p")) (dc-case #t "-" "@" "@" "-" (list "dc" "-e" "10 3%p")) (dc-case #t "-" "@" "@" "-" (list "dc" "-e" "2 10^p")) (dc-case #t "-" "@" "@" "-" (list "dc" "-e" "_7 2/p")) (dc-case #t "-" "@" "@" "-" (list "dc" "-e" "_7 2%p")) (dc-case #t "-" "@" "@" "-" (list "dc" "-e" "7 2~f")) (dc-case #t "-" "@" "@" "-" (list "dc" "-e" "123456789 987654321*p")) (dc-case #t "-" "@" "@" "-" (list "dc" "-e" "2 _2^p")) (dc-case #t "-" "@" "@" "-" (list "dc" "-e" "0 0^p")))
```

## as busybox does it

### the token after a command is read before it runs, so a bad character stops the command before it; a macro is read whole first

```cu

```
